source_plant_findings: Draft Fixture constructs a fixed parent and one dynamic child with a single centered ball collider R=0.1 m and declared mass 0.5 or 2 kg. No second collider/contact counterpart exists.
Revolute X-axis motor frames are both identity/coincident; the joint is ForceBased with k=300 Nm/rad and d=12 Nm s/rad, target +/-0.001 rad or zero, cap 2 or 0.01 Nm, and contacts disabled.
Draft declares/sets zero gravity, body and generalized passive damping, generalized initial velocity and armature; sleeping/CCD are disabled. It checks one DOF/two links/two bodies/one collider.
Draft sets N=1, PGS=1, stabilization=2, CCD partitions maximum=1 and one outer interval. Island solver divides dt by N plus additional island iterations; draft additional body iterations are zero.
Source ordering integrates before stabilization. Integration velocity and final writeback velocity must remain separately assessed.

The isolated centered sphere permits the SI reference I=(2/5)mR^2. The reader must verify actual captured native mass/inertia/coordinate/velocity, not substitute current-row cached inverse mass for physical inertia.

For the ForceBased angular motor, w and g=1/(h*h*k+h*d) both have inverse-inertia units. The candidate changes only D from inv(w) to inv(w+g); this dimensional/source consistency is not physical accuracy evidence.
